description_en: Removes multiple roles from a single user
description_zh: 将多个角色从单个User中移除
kebab_example: aliyun datalake revoke-roles-from-user --role-names example-string --user example-string --region cn-hangzhou
name: RevokeRolesFromUser

parameters.help_en: The RAM roles to be revoked from the RAM user
parameters.name: role_names

fields.help_en: ram user/ram role principal, in the format of acs:ram::[accountId]:user/userName, acs:ram::[accountId]:role/roleName
fields.name: principal_arn

parameters.help_en:
The RAM user from whom you want to revoke roles. Format:

RAM roles: acs:ram::[accountId]:role/[roleName].
RAM user: acs:ram::[accountId]:user/[userName]
parameters.help_zh:
指定RAM用户或RAM角色。格式如下：

RAM角色：acs:ram::[accountId]:role/[roleName]。

RAM用户：acs:ram::[accountId]:user/[userName]
parameters.name: user

v1_body_parameters.help_en: The HTTP request body, in the JSON format
v1_body_parameters.help_zh: HTTP请求体（HTTP BODY）内容，均采用JSON格式
v1_body_parameters.name: body
